subject: alienFlora
pitch:
Category: Plant.
Subject: bioluminescent alien plant.
Style: Avatar.
reasoning:
I'm designing a bioluminescent alien plant avatar inspired by Pandora flora—roughly 1.8 meters tall with a central stalk, spiral glowing fronds, curled leaves with luminous veins, a bulb flower with tendrils, and helicopter-like ground spires.

Since this is a static model without joints, I can use swept paths freely. I'm planning the root base with buttress sweeps, a tapered main stalk with glowing rings, six large fronds swept along curved arcs with glowing veins, curled helicopter spirals at the base, and a bulb flower with petal extrusions and a glowing core with hanging tendril orbs.

Writing frond sweep logic...

Still shaping the bell outline...

Still writing petal and tendril geometry...

I'm shaping the buttress roots so they taper and sink slightly into the ground plane, then moving to small helicopter-spiral plants near the base -- short stems topped with vertical coiled spirals mimicking the real helicopter plant that curls shut when touched.

Now I'm scattering ground glow nubs on tiny stalks with glowing bulb tops, adding a scatter of floating spore orbs at varying heights around the trunk for subtle ambient detail, and double-checking the sweep geometry picks up the glow material correctly.

Adding glowing rings and spiral dots along the stalk...

Setting up the color palette and leaf band gradients, then writing the frond generation function with base points and direction vectors along the stalk.

Adding side veins to the leaf...
